status: Screening candidate and illustrative loads only; no resistor selection is installed or thermally qualified

candidate.reference_board: 39 x 30 x 1.6 mm FR4, double-sided 70 um copper; not this PCB
candidate.library_footprint_status: Not prepared; cooling architecture must be resolved first
candidate.procurement_status: Exact 1500 search found no entries in the existing local JLCPCB snapshot; live sourcing unverified

assumptions: Bus voltages and 65 V illustration are calculation scenarios, not approved bus ratings or limits
150 ohm is the proposed 56 V branch of an unresolved installed variant value
External resistor scenarios are not BOM selections
Nominal rows omit tolerances; the additional OC screen uses explicit datasheet terms and unqualified engineering allowances and excludes dynamic/fault qualification
Current model includes nominal R164 but neglects MOSFET and wiring resistance
Bulk-only discharge assumes no incoming source or motor energy and established bulk return
Average thermal screening cannot qualify startup, repeated pulses, faults or transient thermal impedance
release_requirements: Resolve exact R160 value, MPN, package and assembly sourcing
Design and verify thermal path for default resistor, including brake held on and coupled heat from other parts
Bound external resistor range against worst-case OC threshold and required regeneration power
Qualify pulse energy, repetition and maximum bus overshoot
Complete PCB power/Kelvin layout and fault-priority timing
Measure thermal, brake current and regenerative behavior with target motor/source

oc_screen.status: Conditional steady-state engineering envelope; not an installed-BOM guarantee or a fault-current rating

origins.avcc: Engineering +/-5% supply envelope, consistent with existing OV review; not claimed TPS7A20 accuracy or valid during startup/rail collapse
origins.divider: Engineering +/-2% total resistor envelope; R165/R166 exact MPNs remain unspecified
origins.shunt: Prospective Bourns 2 mOhm candidate +/-4% total engineering envelope, allowing initial, temperature, solder and aging effects; candidate is not installed and cumulative drift is not guaranteed
origins.ina: TI INA181 Rev H section 6.5: gain +/-1% already covers -40..125 C; do not add gain drift again. 500 uV offset referenced to general 12 V condition, 1 uV/C drift, 40 uV/V PSRR and 84 dB full-temperature CMRR used additively
origins.comparator: TI TLV3201 Rev C sections 6.5/6.7: 4 mV full-temperature offset at midsupply. 8 mV is an engineering allowance including CM/PS sensitivity. Hysteresis has only a typical entry; 0..3 mV per rising edge is an unqualified engineering allowance
origins.leakage: 5 nA comparator full-temperature bias plus 10 nA board allowance
origins.reference_and_kelvin: Separate layout/error budgets; neither is established by the current incomplete copper
origins.external: Illustrative +/-10% combined tolerance/temperature envelope, no resistor MPN selected
origins.headroom: Provisional engineering requirement: maximum steady brake current <=80% of the screened minimum trip; not a pulse or short-circuit guarantee
origins.onboard: Prospective +/-10% total envelope for the 150 ohm default branch, covering the mounting proposal as well as the earlier candidate; not a qualified supplied-part bound

excluded: Dynamic overshoot and current rise during amplifier/comparator/latch/gate delay
INA181 large-signal recovery and output loading/oscillation
Startup, unpowered domains, brownout and sensor open/short faults
Kelvin thermoelectric offsets beyond the differential allowance
Actual shunt thermal/pulse qualification and resistor production/sourcing qualification

mounting_proposal.status: Preferred mechanical direction for design; not installed or qualified
mounting_proposal.family: Vishay LTO 100, 150 ohm, TO-247 radial leads
mounting_proposal.ordering_code_note: Derived from manufacturer ordering convention; exact supplied part and availability not yet verified
mounting_proposal.mounting: Through-hole connection on the controller PCB; ceramic back screwed to a dedicated heatsink. Position and orientation pending mechanical/CAD design.
requirements: Case-to-ambient budget includes contact interface and heatsink together, not the heatsink catalogue number alone
Use manufacturer mounting instructions; shared heatsink heat from MOSFETs must be added before any shared design is accepted
Default resistor must be supplied and mounted as part of the controller assembly; external motor-braking resistor remains a separate load through J13
Verify lead geometry, hole tolerances, body/fastener/heatsink clearance and assembly access before adopting a footprint
Manufacturer document contains differing TCR entries, including typical values; the +/-10% total resistance budget is an engineering screen, not a manufacturer bound
Part sourcing, supplied-data applicability, pulse/repetition, vibration and thermal measurements remain open
mounting_proposal.alternative_screen: Bourns PWR221T-50 current manufacturer data gives 2.5 C/W. Under the same 27.589 W, 50 C ambient and 125 C element target it would need <=0.219 C/W case-to-ambient; LTO 100 allows <=1.219 C/W, before extra margin.
